description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for a rear roof extension, additional solar panels to rear roof, three front roof windows, alterations to basement lightwell location, alterations to heat pumps and bin and cycle storage, addition of a balcony to front first floor flat, amendments to ground and first floor doors and windows and boundary brick edging following planning permission 00499/79/P8 for demolition of existing retail unit and erection of a two storey building to provide one terraced house and one retail unit with apartment above, both including basement levels with one front light-wells, car parking, cycle and bin shelters and associated amenity space and roof alterations to No. 79.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun on or before 02/11/2023.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (New documents: Drawings 000(Rev.07), 100(Rev.07), 101(Rev.05), 102(Rev.02), 200(Rev.04) and 201(Rev.04) [received 30/03/2022] and Location Plan and Planning Statement [received 05/10/2021].
Original documents (still applicable): Revised Energy Statements (Retail & Residential, Rev. 2.0), BRUKL Output Data and Carbon Factors Data [received 29/10/2020]. Basic Compliance Reports (Units 1 & 2), SAP Calculations (Units 1 & 2) and Thermal/Ventilation Data [received 26/10/2020]. Drawing 001 (PV Layout) [received 09/10/2020]. Highways Statement and Bike Storage Specifications (A0330) [received 05/10/2020]. Drawings OS01, 01, 02, 03, 20127/01, 20127/02, 20127/TK01 and 20127/TK02, Site Photographs, Design & Access Statement and Flood Risk Assessment [received 20/08/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions and new buildings hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building (matching brickwork, render, roof tiles and windows/doors), unless otherwise indicated on the approved drawings.

Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Contaminated Land Remediation Strategy and Verification Plan', 'Contaminated Land Risk Assessment Phase 1 Desk Study Report' and 'Contaminated Land Risk Assessment Phase 2 Environmental Site Investigation Report' approved on 29/11/2021 under application 00499/79/P8(6,8).
During the course of the development:
   c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
   d.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, the four existing bollards on the footway directly to the south of the site on the Edensor Road footway shall have been removed and the footway reinstated.

Condition : 9 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the vehicular access to the front of the new dwelling, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected or allowed to grow within the areas of these splays on land within the approved development site.

Condition : 10 - Prior to first occupation of the dwelling hereby approved, details of both hard and soft landscape works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved. These details shall include (means of enclosure; any vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc). 
Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications [including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment]; schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme).

Condition : 11 - Before first occupation of the building(s) hereby approved the cycle parking spaces and the access to them shall be provided in accordance with the scheme shown on drawings 000(07) and 100(07) and the submitted Bike Storage Specifications (A0330), and such spaces shall be permanently available for the users of the building(s) without obstruction.

Condition : 12 - Prior to first occupation of the flats hereby approved, full details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 13 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less.

Condition : 14 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the dwelling hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 15 - The commercial unit hereby approved shall only be used for Class E only and for no other purpose without further permission from Local Planning Authority.
